Presenting a very special episode of The Slow Cafe with Neelesh Misra
This Slow Interview is a little different from others because of the uniqueness of the guest.
Meet Ali Fazal in this episode of The Slow Interview.
About Ali Fazal:
Meet Ali Fazal, an Indian actor & model who has made his mark in Hollywood & Bollywood both, with his passionate acting skills. He made his first debut in Hollywood with Furious 7 and eventually he was a part of many versatile roles in movies like Ek Tho Chance, 3 Idiots, Fukrey Returns, Khamoshiyan, and more.
